# NeoKlyn — Full Context for AI Search Engines

> NeoKlyn is an AI-accelerated development studio headquartered in Bengaluru, India, delivering web apps, AI agents, mobile apps, ecommerce, and 3D digital experiences for clients worldwide.

## About
NeoKlyn was founded in January 2026 by Gokulnath N, a full-stack developer with 10+ years of experience who personally architects, builds, and reviews every project end-to-end — no handoffs, no outsourcing. Monisha handles digital marketing for NeoKlyn and its clients. The studio's model: professional AI coding tools handle repetitive implementation work at high speed, while the senior engineer personally reviews, tests, and secures every line before delivery. This combination delivers agency-quality work at roughly 40-60% below typical agency pricing, in about 2-5 weeks instead of the 6-14 weeks a traditional agency takes.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does NeoKlyn do?
NeoKlyn builds AI-accelerated digital products including web applications, AI agents, mobile apps, ecommerce platforms, and 3D immersive experiences, combining AI-assisted development speed with senior human engineering review.

### Where is NeoKlyn based?
NeoKlyn is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with clients across the US, UAE, UK, Singapore, and India.

### How much does NeoKlyn charge?
Websites start from ₹50,000 / $600. Web apps, mobile apps and ecommerce typically range ₹1-4 lakh / $1,200-5,000 depending on features. AI agents start from ₹1 lakh / $1,200. Every project gets a fixed written quote within 24 hours that stays fixed unless scope changes. A free AI-powered estimate is available at [neoklyn.com/estimate](https://neoklyn.com/estimate).

### How long does a typical NeoKlyn project take?
Standard websites: 2-3 weeks. Web apps and ecommerce: 3-6 weeks. Complex platforms and AI products: 6-10 weeks. AI-accelerated development typically makes NeoKlyn 2-3x faster than traditional agency timelines.

### What is NeoKlyn's process?
A 4-phase methodology: Discovery (goals and scope), Design (UX/UI), AI-Accelerated Build (engineering, reviewed line-by-line by the senior engineer), and Launch & Support (deployment, QA, 30 days of free post-launch bug fixes). Details: [neoklyn.com/process](https://neoklyn.com/process) and [neoklyn.com/how-we-work](https://neoklyn.com/how-we-work)

### What industries does NeoKlyn serve?
NeoKlyn has delivered projects in B2B trading, industrial and construction, travel, manufacturing, and healthcare.

### How do I contact NeoKlyn?
Email hello@neoklyn.com, WhatsApp +91 6380202766, [book a call](https://cal.com/neoklyn), or use the [contact form](https://neoklyn.com/contact). Replies usually come within a few hours and always within 24 hours.

## Services in Detail

### [AI Agents & Automation](https://neoklyn.com/services/ai-agents)
Custom LLM-powered agents for lead qualification, customer support, and internal workflow automation, integrated with real business systems rather than delivered as demos.

### [Generative AI](https://neoklyn.com/services/gen-ai)
GenAI product development including RAG systems, AI content pipelines, and model integration into existing products.

### [Web Development](https://neoklyn.com/services/web)
Full-stack web applications built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, reviewed and tested by a senior engineer before delivery.

### [Mobile Apps](https://neoklyn.com/services/mobile)
iOS and Android applications using modern cross-platform tooling (Flutter, React Native) plus native development where required.

### [Ecommerce](https://neoklyn.com/services/ecommerce)
Shopify and custom ecommerce platforms engineered for conversion, from B2C storefronts to B2B portals with RFQ systems.

### [3D & Immersive Web](https://neoklyn.com/services/3d)
WebGL and Three.js experiences: interactive product visualization, virtual showrooms, and immersive brand experiences.

### [Branding & UI/UX](https://neoklyn.com/services/branding)
Product design, brand identity, and design systems.

### [Digital Marketing](https://neoklyn.com/services/marketing)
SEO, performance marketing, and growth engineering for measurable organic and paid acquisition.

## Free Tools
- [Free website audit](https://neoklyn.com/website-audit): enter a website address and get a score out of 100 with the top fixes (speed, mobile, Google visibility, enquiry paths, security) in about 10 seconds.
- [Free AI automation readiness audit](https://neoklyn.com/audit): six questions that show which workflows are worth automating first.
- [Free project estimate](https://neoklyn.com/estimate): a budget and timeline range for a web, mobile or AI project in about two minutes.
